purpose: Teach: めど/取組み/先着/借入金/略称/一級/推察/親密

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、今月内にめどをつけろ
lines.en: Get this sorted for the company by month's end.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. No softening. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time. Clean exhale at the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の取組みを開始しました
lines.en: Understood. We've already begun work on the new venture.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight lift on 'begun' — showing readiness. Steady posture. Not rushed, not slow. The careful clarity of someone reporting upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様、先着順でご招待しろ
lines.en: Invite our key clients first-come, first-served.
lines.style: Sharp instruction, no room for interpretation. Quick tempo. The weight of expectation behind each word. Brief pause after 'first-served' — letting it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。借入金の返済計画を提出いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the loan repayment schedule submitted.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Almost reflexive in its professionalism. Leaning slightly forward — the posture of someone ready to move. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の略称、商標登録を確認しろ
lines.en: Verify that our company abbreviation is trademark-registered.
lines.style: Clipped, procedural. Each task a separate weight. Slight hardening on 'verify.' The cadence of a checklist spoken aloud but with authority behind it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。一級建築士の採用を進めております
lines.en: Understood. I'm working on bringing a licensed architect onto the team.
lines.style: Present-tense, active. Steady voice. The implication that progress is already underway. Calm, competent. Not defending, just reporting momentum.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様のお気持ちを推察しろ
lines.en: Think carefully about what our clients actually need.
lines.style: Slower pace. The words weighted — not rushed instruction but something closer to principle. Almost paternal. Slight emphasis on 'actually.' Letting it breathe.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様との親密な関係を保ちます
lines.en: Understood. I'll maintain a strong, attentive relationship with our key accounts.
lines.style: Warm assurance beneath the formality. Slight lean — more personal than the earlier responses. Soft conviction on 'maintain.' The tone of someone who has heard what matters.
